newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $2.1 bln for this week.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $2.1 bln for this week.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for this week are expected to total $2.1 billion in 99 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $1.3 billion in 41 sales, with a $150 million Sacramento Municipal Utility District, Calif., deal through Goldman, Sachs & Co., topping the list.
On the competitive side, 58 sales totaling $793 million are scheduled. A $265 million Washington deal on Wednesday is the largest.
An additional seven sales totaling $502 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues this week depending on market conditions.
